lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh pubspec.lock (transitive dependencies) once a week, all of Monday (UTC). The preset default 'before 4am on monday' is never hit: the scheduled workflow runs in the afternoon and starts hours late.

packageRules.description: Digest updates once a week, all of Monday (UTC). The scheduled workflow starts hours late, so a narrow window was never hit.
Renovate releases several times a day, so updating it opened a PR almost daily. Once a month, all of the 1st (UTC), as one PR.
Raise the ^ floors in pubspec.yaml along with pubspec.lock, as Dependabot did, so the declared minimum follows what is actually tested.
Keep the caret on the Dart SDK constraint: its default versioning rewrites ^3.12.0 to an exact version, which fails pub get on any other SDK.
Only move the Dart SDK floor on a new minor; a patch release is no reason to raise it.
